When the creature dies, Sifa Grent, Abzan Ascendancy and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Sifa Grent trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Abzan Ascendancy ability, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Sifa Grent triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

222-527-4742-6495.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

Move to your first extra turn.
Activate Ral Zarek's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, tapping a permanent and untapping a permanent.
At the beginning of your end step, Atraxa triggers, putting a loyalty counter on Ral Zarek.
Repeat from step 4 during your second and third extra turns, and repeat step 5 during your fourth extra turn.
Repeat from step 1 during your fifth extra turns.

Resolve the Dimir Aqueduct trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Evolution Sage trigger, putting an indestructible counter on Myojin of Cryptic Dreams.
Repeat from step 3 two additional times.
Repeat from step 2.

Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{R}{R}.

Activate an Eldrazi Scion by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
